_about: How the three press styles move the body through a strike (docs/animation/press-styles.md). Render only, outside the sim's data hash; it never moves a blow's contact tick, only how the body gets there and leaves. Used only with RenderAnim.press_styles (--press-styles, default OFF). Times are 60 Hz ticks. read: how a blow's style is chosen when the beat does not name one (rhythm = tech when the press log reads timed, mash, taps and no read = speed, as VFX reads it; a heavy blow is always heavy; a hold that is not a heavy blow plays the profile it plays today). styles.<id>.prof: overrides of the part's timing profile (data/anim/profiles.json fields; hold_ticks is new: the contact key held that long before the follow-through starts). alternate: the striking limb alternates blow to blow. carry: a blow that starts while the last one is still in its follow or recover blends out of that pose (the retract) instead of out of the guard, over carry_ticks. squash: how much of the squash pose's legs, pelvis and spine the wind-up takes (0 to 1, scaled by the blow's weight), lean_back: extra spine lean back at full squash (rad), back: the body drawn this far back at full squash (model units). stretch: the release. spine: spine extension (rad), rise: hips up (model units), lead: the body drawn this far ahead (model units), ticks: how long it takes to settle after contact, smear_ticks: the ticks before contact that count as the smear frame. twist: the loose body's spine yaw toward the striking side (rad) over twist_ticks. ghosts: how many afterimage copies VFX is asked for (press.ghosts). squash_pose: the pose whose legs, pelvis and spine are the squash (a pose id), bones: which bones it takes.
_beat: What the beat tells (Encounter's slice B0, docs/director/brawl-b0.md: style, grade, k, n, closing, charge, hand, ender; a chainStrike carries a and d as a strike does). grade: a tech blow's held beat and the after-images asked of VFX by the press grade (perfect, good, off, none). closing: the least a string's closing or ending blow holds its follow-through. charge: a heavy's wind-up is `load_min` of its length when tapped and the whole when held, and its squash follows the blow's weight from `tapped` to `held`. hand (r or l) is the striking side outright, the beat's own over the alternation by k. style comes from the beat, and the press log is read only for a beat that names none.
_guard: The guard layer a check is thrown over (defensive X, docs/animation/next-waves-sizing.md): a beat with `check: true` keeps the arm that is not striking in the guard pose (the pose's clavicle, upper arm, forearm and hand, and its finger curl) at `weight`, closing over the wind-up and opening over the return; a foot, knee or head blow keeps both arms. push (a style row): a push has no impact snap, the blow drives into its contact over 5 ticks, a long follow-through, a body drive.
_riposte: The brawl's riposte (docs/animation/press-styles.md section 12): the blocker's counter blow leaves from his block pose (s3.perfect_block, or s3.reversal for a reversal), which is its wind-up, as a zip's tell is. windup: the ticks the strike block cuts its own wind-up to for a riposte (light, heavy), with no squash. fade: the ticks before the blow's contact tick over which the block pose fades out. style and grade: what a riposte plays when its beat names none (a perfect timing: tech and perfect for a light, heavy for a heavy). The stagger of the rival it earns is the step 3 sequence fitted to the cue's ticks and needs no row.
